text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"organized into introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clear structural sequence with paragraphing and a recognizable opening and closing."},{"evidence":"repeated explanation of how the club helps teachers, students, and parents","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay develops its main point with multiple supporting reasons rather than mostly restating the same thought."},{"evidence":"phrases like 'one-on-one class with a teacher' and 'the students proffered way'","quality":"specificity","description":"The essay gives more concrete details and examples to explain its claims."},{"evidence":"sentences such as 'The club would give students extra time to understand the subject' and 'The club makes people feel welcome'","quality":"sentence clarity","description":"The writing is generally easier to follow because its sentences are more complete and comprehensible."},{"evidence":"use of transitions like 'although,' 'not only,' 'because of,' and 'The people who volunteer'","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"The essay connects ideas with more varied discourse markers and linking phrases."},{"evidence":"mostly sustained formal essay style","quality":"register control","description":"The essay more consistently maintains an academic, explanatory tone appropriate for a persuasive essay."}]}
